title: Reject Extra
statement: Implement `solve(payload, allowed)`. `payload` is a dict and `allowed` is a list of keys. Return the sorted list of keys present in the payload that are not allowed. An empty list means the payload has no extras.
constraints: Allowed keys that are absent are fine
hints: Set of payload keys minus set of allowed keys.
Do not return the allowed keys.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: An extra key is how a client smuggles a field your model should reject, or how you notice a typo.

editorial: An extra key is how a client smuggles a field your model should reject, or how you notice a typo. The difference of the two sets is the unknown keys. Sorting makes the report stable.
reference_solution:
def solve(payload, allowed):
    return sorted(set(payload) - set(allowed))
